comparison.selectedCase: NIST Table 4 case 0 · 285 W · 960 mm/s · D4σ 67 µm
reasons: Executed model/core identity does not match the NIST comparison allowlisted transient core.
The run is a 600 µm square-domain powder-layer scan; the observed source case is a continuous 10 mm +X bare-plate track.
Power, speed, beam diameter, and substrate temperature do not match the selected case.
A measured beam-profile artifact and D4σ-to-model mapping are unavailable.
The six-section optical observation operator and matched section locations are not implemented in the comparison path.
Independent mesh and timestep convergence levels are missing.

limitations: The NIST values are literature measurements stored in a local aggregate transcription; no measurements were generated by this application run.
The transient result uses estimated-legacy IN718 material data with unquantified property uncertainty.

This is software workflow, archive integrity and fail-closed comparison evidence. It does not prove scientific correctness, mesh/time convergence, independent experimental validity, or backend parity.
Performance records only the worker-reported solver interval. Queue wait, process startup, capture, artifact persistence, API and full UI wall time were not separated.
The source revision had been imported and hash-verified earlier in this same preserved isolated store; this acceptance turn selected and re-verified that revision before archiving the new run.
